author.name: R.K. Narayan
author.biography: Rasipuram Krishnaswami Iyer Narayanaswami was an Indian writer known for his works set in the fictional South Indian town of Malgudi.

author.name: Ruskin Bond
author.biography: Ruskin Bond is an Indian author of British descent, known for his children's literature and stories set in the hills of North India.

author.name: A.P.J. Abdul Kalam
author.biography: Avul Pakir Jainulabdeen Abdul Kalam was an Indian aerospace scientist who served as the 11th President of India.

author.name: Rabindranath Tagore
author.biography: Rabindranath Tagore was a polymath who reshaped Bengali literature and music. He became the first non-European to win the Nobel Prize in Literature in 1913.

author.name: Premchand
author.biography: Munshi Premchand was a Hindi writer famous for his modern Hindustani literature. He is one of the most celebrated writers of the Indian subcontinent.

author.name: Vikram Seth
author.biography: Vikram Seth is an Indian novelist and poet. He has written several novels and poetry books and received several awards including Padma Shri.

author.name: Arundhati Roy
author.biography: Arundhati Roy is an Indian author best known for her novel The God of Small Things which won the Man Booker Prize for Fiction in 1997.

author.name: Amish Tripathi
author.biography: Amish Tripathi is an Indian author known for his fiction novels based on Indian mythology, particularly the Shiva Trilogy.

author.name: Chetan Bhagat
author.biography: Chetan Bhagat is an Indian author, columnist, screenwriter, and motivational speaker known for his English-language novels about young urban Indians.

author.name: Sudha Murty
author.biography: Sudha Murty is an Indian educator, author, and philanthropist. She is the chairperson of the Infosys Foundation and has authored numerous books.
